python -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
aest = parse.FixedTzOffset(10 * 60, '+10:00')

# Parse with different formats
r1 = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 AM +1000')
r2 = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 AM +10:00')

print('r1.tzinfo:', r1[0].tzinfo)
print('r2.tzinfo:', r2[0].tzinfo)
print('r1._name:', r1[0].tzinfo._name)
print('r2._name:', r2[0].tzinfo._name)
print('Equal?', r1[0].tzinfo == r2[0].tzinfo)
"
